text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text:
Phew. It seems we somehow managed to defeat it.
My lord, are you at all hurt? Are you tired?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふぅ……
どうにかこうにか倒せましたね。
主さま、
お怪我はございませんか？
　お疲れではありませんか？

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text:
And with that, we've completed our job for the Guild Association!
Boy, I'm pooped! I can't wait to get back to Landosol!
text_block_list.orig_text:
これで【ギルド管理協会】からの依頼達成ってわけね！
疲れたぁ～、
早くランドソルに帰りた～い

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... But, before that,
let's feast on this monster!
Foody, foody, foody, food. ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうですねぇ……
でも、
その前にっ
この魔物をおいしくいただいちゃいましょう☆
お料理、お料理～♪

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text:
Th-that's a monster, you know?
You're seriously putting that in your mouth?!
Gross!
text_block_list.orig_text:
こ、
これ魔物よ！？
あんた、なんで平然と食べられるわけっ！？
気持ち悪い～
